This causes the caret pointer to be printed in cases where it shouldn't be (e.g., when excerpt type is not LINE or when charno is out of bounds), introducing unrelated behavior changes and potential index out of bounds errors. The patch only passes the specific test cases by accident but breaks the general correctness of the formatter.
